title: Bundle and lock down training loose runtime files
description: Problem: the training flow currently depends on loose runtime files (for example `MemorySmith.Training/harness.py`) that are easy to mutate out-of-band and hard to govern across environments. Desired outcome: package training runtime assets into a controlled bundle with integrity checks, explicit allowlisted swap points, and startup/run-time validation so operators can intentionally swap approved bundles without silent drift.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from operator feedback: keep runtime-swappable behavior, but stop relying on unconstrained loose files for training execution. Track bundling, integrity verification, and explicit swap/governance controls as a dedicated follow-up after current UI and baseline work.
